description.value: Fatburger is a Canadian-owned fast food burger chain founded in 1947 by Lovie Yancey in Los Angeles, with its first Canadian location opening in Vancouver in 2005. The Kelowna outlet on Harvey Avenue serves made-to-order burgers using fresh, never-frozen Alberta Angus beef alongside chicken sandwiches, wings, milkshakes, and plant-based options. It is a convenient quick-stop for cyclists travelling along Harvey Avenue (Highway 97).
